name: Owlbear
who: an owlbear, a huge beast with the heavy body, thick limbs and clawed paws of a giant bear, covered in shaggy slate-blue fur with a few old pink scars, and the head of a great horned owl with tall ear tufts, a pale facial disc, amber eyes and a hooked grey beak
stow: The fur lies close to the limbs, so the outline of each arm and each leg stands clear of the body.
